_notes: MCP server configuration for clients other than Claude Code (Cursor, Zed, Antigravity and others).
Copy one of the two entries into your client's mcpServers block.
eclipse: stdio through the launcher, which finds the running Eclipse and reads the token file
itself, so no token goes into this file. Replace the path with your clone's launcher.
eclipse-http: plain HTTP to the plug-in. Paste the token from ~/.config/eclipse-mcp/token,
or copy the whole entry from Eclipse: MCP > Server Status... > Copy Setup.
